procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
f/u after CMV colitis. Finished valganciclovir 11/14. Saw GI in December, no changes, mesalamine continues. Now 1-3 stools a day, formed or soft, no blood, no cramping. Eating more; weight 57 (up 2).
ART: partner-set blister packs every morning; he says he's missed "a couple" since November. HIV clinic in December — no paperwork with him.
Fluconazole 200 daily.

Exam: thin, better color. Vitals per flowsheet. No thrush. Abdomen soft, nontender. Neuro: left-sided weakness, wide-based gait, unchanged.

A/P
1. CMV colitis — treated, resolved.
2. UC quiet on mesalamine — CMP.
3. HIV/AIDS per HIV clinic; keep going with the packs.
4. Anemia — CBC.
5. Weight up — continue supplements.
Physical in May.

documents.title: Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hemoglobin is creeping back up. Kidney and liver tests normal, protein level fine. Keep doing what you're doing.

documents.title: mesalamine
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Last refill on the mesalamine — can you renew it?

documents.title: RE: mesalamine
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Renewed mesalamine DR 1.2 g, 4 tablets daily, 90 days x 3 refills.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam, 39M.

No hospital stays since October. Says this is the longest stretch he's felt steady in a few years. Working full days again from home.
HIV: Biktarvy daily from blister packs; HIV clinic every 3 months. Fluconazole 200 daily continues per them.
UC: 1-2 stools, no blood. Mesalamine.
PML: left hand still clumsy for fine tasks, gait unsteady but he's doing the home exercises. Memory unchanged per partner.
Mood good; PHQ-9 3.

Meds: Biktarvy daily, fluconazole 200 mg daily, mesalamine DR 4.8 g daily, multivitamin. NKDA.
Social: lives with partner. Never smoker, no alcohol.

Exam: thin, well-appearing. Vitals per flowsheet; weight 58. HEENT: no thrush, no oral lesions. No lymphadenopathy. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin: healed graft sites. Neuro: left arm and leg weaker than right; wide-based gait.

A/P
- HIV/AIDS on Biktarvy, cryptococcal maintenance fluconazole — per HIV clinic.
- UC in remission — CMP.
- PML with stable residual deficits.
- Anemia — CBC.
- Prevention: lipids, A1c. Vaccines current; flu/COVID this fall. Colorectal screening not yet due by age; GI will plan UC surveillance.
Follow-up in September.
